title: Subfluid
tagline: A Superfluid-powered subscription streaming follow module for Lens

prizes.placement: 🤝 Lens Protocol —  "follow on lens" or "sign in with lens"
prizes.title: Lens Protocol

description: A follow module for Lens Protocol similar to paid follow, but that enforces a continuous payment stream through Superfluid to remain a subscriber/follower. The Graph and EPNS are used to make reading on-chain data more accessible, and to alert users of follow and subscription stream events.
how_its_made: The contracts are built in a Hardhat environment, using Alchemy. Superfluid and Lens Protocol are integrated at the smart contract level. The frontend is built in React and integrates The Graph and EPNS to make reading on-chain data more accessible and to create on-chain event-based user alerts.
